insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (Base Sum Insured + Booster+ Sum Insured + Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured as per Policy Schedule)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: You can choose any room without a daily rent limit, giving you freedom to select your preferred accommodation. However, higher room costs may reduce your available Sum Insured faster.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure ‘Forever’. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: After your first claim, an unlimited extra Sum Insured buffer activates and remains for life if you renew continuously. This greatly increases your claim capacity beyond the base Sum Insured.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: “Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’.”
great.explanation: Non-payable items like gloves and masks are covered when you opt for Safeguard/Safeguard+, reducing unexpected hospital bill deductions. This lowers your out-of-pocket expenses.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of a Pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from policy start, which is within the acceptable range. Coverage begins after this continuous period if declared and accepted.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of the listed conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.”
good.explanation: Specific illnesses and procedures have a 24-month waiting period, which is standard in the market. Claims for these conditions are payable after this period.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an Accident…”
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents, which are covered immediately. This is a common waiting period in health insurance.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “We will pay expenses incurred on consultations, medicines, physiotherapy, diagnostic tests for 60 days before the date of admission…”
good.explanation: Expenses up to 60 days before hospital admission are covered, which is a good pre-hospitalization period. This helps cover early treatment costs related to hospitalization.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “…and 180 days after date of discharge IF these are related to the condition for which hospitalization claim is paid.”
good.explanation: Expenses up to 180 days after discharge are covered if related to the hospitalization. This is a solid post-hospitalization coverage period.

good.name: Domiciliary Treatment
good.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home which in normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home…”
good.explanation: Treatment taken at home when hospital care is normally needed is covered under domiciliary treatment. This benefit supports care in home settings under certain conditions.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: No restore/reinstatement clause found in the provided policy wording extract. The policy instead describes ReAssure+/ReAssureX and Booster+ mechanisms.
bad.reference: Mandatory feature check (Restore Benefit) — not explicitly stated
bad.explanation: The policy does not explicitly replenish your base Sum Insured after a claim within the policy year. Without restore, your available cover reduces after each claim.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: No explicit “No Claim Bonus / Cumulative Bonus increase at renewal” benefit statement found (other than wellness discount and inflation-linked Safeguard/Safeguard+).
bad.reference: Mandatory feature check (NCB/Renewal Bonus) — not explicitly stated
bad.explanation: There is no stated No Claim Bonus that increases your Sum Insured on renewal for claim-free years. This means your cover does not grow automatically over time.

bad.name: Air Ambulance
bad.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. Maximum INR 2,50,000 per hospitalization.”
bad.explanation: Air ambulance is covered but limited to ₹2.5 lakh per hospitalization, which may be insufficient in some emergencies. Costs exceeding this limit will not be reimbursed.

bad.name: Modern Treatments
bad.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments as specified below:”
bad.explanation: Coverage for modern treatments is restricted to a specified list. Treatments not on this list may not be covered, limiting your access to newer procedures.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: “If you opt for a Hospital room which is higher than the eligible room category as specified in your Policy Schedule, then We will pay only a pro-rated portion of the total Associated Medical Expenses…”
bad.explanation: If you choose a room higher than your eligible category, claim payments may be reduced proportionally. This can significantly lower your claim amount if you select a more expensive room.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: “Co-Payment: It is the percentage of admissible claim amount You would have to bear, Rest we will pay.”
bad.explanation: The policy mentions co-payment but does not specify the percentage or when it applies. You need to check your policy schedule to know your exact co-pay details.

unclear.name: Room Rent Option
unclear.quote: “You can as per your lifestyle, choose to change the room category we are offering… You can choose between a Single Private Room and a Sharing Room.”
unclear.explanation: You can select between single or sharing rooms, but the default eligibility and impact on claims depend on your policy schedule. Confirm your plan details to avoid unexpected deductions.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
